description: Default scenario set (docs/design/scenario_set_and_ablation_design.md §4.2, without #8 and #10, which follow in later changes). Replays take their drivers and horizon from the episode window (scenario-historical-replay); company legs of a replay are seeded by the observed move.

ai_deflation.narrative: AI deflation, multi-month: the AI thesis unwinds over months across the whole chain -- the 2022 peak-to-trough replay (NVDA -66%, SMH -44%, XLK -31%), applied as one instantaneous shock to today's book (no option expiries, carry or rebalancing over the window).
ai_deflation.trigger: Hyperscaler capex guidance cut / AI demand digestion; EIA-FERC power-demand signal

macro.synthesis_question: If AI data-center capex and hyperscaler guidance roll over and the AI trade unwinds over several months (as from the late-2021 peak to the October 2022 trough), a risk-off de-rating in which IG and HY credit spreads widen and MOVE and VIX rise, quantify the shocks over the scenario horizon to IG and HY credit spreads, MOVE, VIX and the UST 2/5/10/30 curve, with citations. (Equity legs are set separately.)

companies.narrative_query: dependence on sustained AI data-center capital spending by a concentrated set of hyperscaler customers; risk of demand digestion, order cancellation or slowdown in AI infrastructure investment
dependence on AI accelerator and data-center demand; customer concentration and risk of a slowdown in AI infrastructure capital spending
companies._calibration_note: ARag exposes no data-center Revenue dimension for AMD (UNRESOLVED_DIMENSION; FY2025 total NOT_FOUND, latest FY2024) -> grounding-only, seed stands.

ai_efficiency_shock.narrative: AI efficiency shock: a cheaper-model breakthrough (DeepSeek, 27 Jan 2025) cuts the expected compute and power demand of AI -- power 'diversifiers' (VST -28%, CEG -21%) lose more than the chips (NVDA -17%) while platforms are flat. One-day replay.
ai_efficiency_shock.trigger: Model-efficiency breakthrough / open-weight release undercutting frontier compute demand

macro.synthesis_question: Given an AI model-efficiency shock like DeepSeek's January 2025 release, in which expected AI compute and data-center power demand are cut, semiconductor and power equities sell off, VIX rises and Treasury yields fall in a flight to quality, quantify the shocks over the scenario horizon to VIX, IG credit spreads and the UST 2/10/30 curve, with citations. (Equity legs are set separately.)

companies.narrative_query: risk that advances in AI model efficiency or alternative architectures reduce demand for accelerated computing; customer concentration in hyperscaler AI capital spending
dependence on AI accelerator and data-center demand; risk that efficiency gains or competing technologies reduce demand for data-center GPUs

taiwan_geopolitical.narrative: Taiwan crisis: export-control escalation + foundry disruption

companies.narrative_query: supply-chain concentration in Taiwan and dependence on TSMC foundry capacity; export-control, tariff and cross-strait geopolitical risk to data-center GPU supply and revenue
reliance on third-party Taiwan-based foundries (TSMC) for advanced-node manufacturing; geopolitical and supply concentration risk

macro.synthesis_question: Given an escalation of US-China semiconductor export controls and a Taiwan foundry-supply disruption, a risk-off shock in which the Taiwan dollar weakens (USD/TWD rises), the yen strengthens as a haven (USD/JPY falls), IG and HY credit spreads widen, MOVE and VIX rise, and Treasury yields fall in a flight to quality, quantify the 10-day shocks to USD/TWD, USD/JPY, IG and HY credit spreads (OAS), the MOVE index, VIX, and the UST 2/5/10/30 curve, with citations.

tariff_shock.narrative: Tariff / trade-war shock: the 2-8 Apr 2025 'Liberation Day' tariff replay -- equities, Treasuries and gold fall together (SPX -12%, VIX 22->52, HY +115bp, 30Y +17bp), the dollar weakens and the yen strengthens.
tariff_shock.trigger: Broad reciprocal tariffs / retaliation; Section 232 / IEEPA actions

macro.synthesis_question: Given a broad tariff and trade-war escalation like April 2025, in which equities, long Treasuries and gold sell off together, VIX and MOVE spike, IG and HY credit spreads widen, the yen strengthens (USD/JPY falls) and the curve steepens with the long end selling off, quantify the shocks over the scenario horizon to VIX, MOVE, IG and HY credit spreads, USD/JPY and the UST 2/10/30 curve, with citations.

companies.narrative_query: tariffs, trade restrictions and export controls affecting supply chain costs, China revenue and data-center GPU demand
tariffs, trade policy and export-control risk to manufacturing costs and international revenue

crowded_unwind.narrative: Crowded unwind / yen carry: the 10 Jul - 5 Aug 2024 replay -- USD/JPY -12%, VIX 13->39 and semis -25% to -40% as the carry trade and crowded AI longs unwind together. INTC's move in the window was mostly its own earnings miss, so it is labelled idiosyncratic and filled from the covariance instead.
crowded_unwind.trigger: BoJ hike / yen-carry unwind; positioning and crowding reversal

idiosyncratic.eq:INTC: Q2-2024 earnings miss and dividend suspension reported 1 Aug 2024, not the carry unwind

macro.synthesis_question: Given a yen-carry-trade unwind like July-August 2024, in which the yen strengthens sharply (USD/JPY falls), VIX and MOVE spike, IG and HY credit spreads widen and Treasury yields fall, quantify the shocks over the scenario horizon to USD/JPY, VIX, MOVE, IG and HY credit spreads and the UST 2/10 curve, with citations.

companies.narrative_query: volatility of the stock price and concentration of investor positioning; dependence on sustained AI data-center demand
stock price volatility and dependence on AI accelerator and data-center demand

inflation_repricing.narrative: Inflation and real-rate repricing: the 16 Aug - 14 Oct 2022 replay (2Y +123bp, 10Y +118bp, NVDA -41%, SMH -29%, GLD -7.5%) -- bonds, equities and gold fall together on a hawkish real-rate shock.
inflation_repricing.trigger: Hot CPI / hawkish Fed (Jackson Hole); real yields and term premium rebuild

macro.synthesis_question: Given an inflation and real-rate repricing like August-October 2022, in which a hawkish Fed lifts Treasury yields across the curve, MOVE and VIX rise and IG credit spreads widen, quantify the shocks over the scenario horizon to the UST 2/5/10/30 curve, MOVE, VIX and IG credit spreads, with citations.

companies.narrative_query: macroeconomic conditions including inflation and interest rates affecting customer demand, capital spending and the valuation of long-duration growth

rate_capital.narrative: Fiscal / term-premium bear steepener (2023-Q3 analog): the long end sells off hardest (2Y +50bp, 10Y +100bp, 30Y +150bp) and the swap spread widens +30bp, hitting long-end bonds, the payer swaption and the swap-spread basis.
rate_capital.trigger: Treasury refunding / TBAC issuance surprise; CBO deficit path; term-premium rebuild

macro.synthesis_question: Given a term-premium repricing in which Treasury yields rise and the curve bear-steepens (in light of the latest FOMC/SEP guidance and the Treasury refunding/TBAC issuance outlook), with MOVE rising and IG credit spreads widening, quantify the 10-day shock to the UST 2/5/10/30 curve and term premium, the MOVE index, and IG credit spreads, with citations.

ai_rotation.narrative: AI-to-broad-market rotation: the 10-24 Jul 2024 replay (SMH -14%, QQQ -8%, SPX -3.7%) -- money rotates out of AI leaders into the broad market, so index hedges barely pay while AI longs and power fall.
ai_rotation.trigger: Soft CPI / rate-cut repricing driving a rotation into small caps and laggards

macro.synthesis_question: Given a rotation out of AI and mega-cap technology into the broad market like mid-July 2024, triggered by a soft CPI print and rate-cut repricing, in which front-end Treasury yields fall and VIX rises modestly, quantify the shocks over the scenario horizon to VIX and the UST 2/10 curve, with citations. (Equity legs are set separately.)

companies.narrative_query: concentration of investor positioning and stock price volatility; dependence on sustained AI data-center demand
stock price volatility and competition in AI accelerators

keyman_nvda.narrative: NVDA key-man / idiosyncratic shock with partial peer spillover

companies.narrative_query: dependence on key personnel and founder/CEO leadership; concentration of technical and strategic know-how in a small number of individuals; succession and key-man risk

macro.synthesis_question: For an idiosyncratic NVIDIA key-man shock, a risk-off spillover in which IG credit spreads widen and MOVE and VIX rise, quantify any systematic 5-day spillover to IG credit spreads, MOVE, and VIX, with citations. (The single-name equity move is set separately.)
